svg.title: One Cohort, Seventeen Monetized Opportunities
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-annual-parcel-cohort-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: One Cohort, Seventeen Monetized Opportunities; subtitle: Annual illustrative funnel supporting the Base operator-revenue mix; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: The same 400 unique parcel opportunities flow through every stage; each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Conversions are planning assumptions, not observed performance. The cohort represents a mature annual operating period, not a promise to close within the first 30 days.; caption: Seventeen outcomes comprise four telecom spread transactions, five billboard assignments, and eight IOS activations. The IOS revenue mix assumes twelve billed months per activated yard.; stages: label: Mapped opportunities; value: 400 unique parcel records; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Deduplicate by parcel and proposed rights package before counting. Capture source date, owner contact route, traffic or telecom evidence, and the proposed use.; label: Desktop-qualified opportunities; value: 200 parcels; 50% of mapped; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Remove incompatible zoning, unsuitable access, obvious sign-spacing conflicts, and absent buyer demand. Retain a recorded reason for every exclusion.; label: Owner-engaged opportunities; value: 80 parcels; 40% of qualified; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Confirm the owner's identity and transaction interest, obtain relevant leases, and establish a credible route to inspect title and site conditions.; label: Controlled diligence opportunities; value: 24 parcels; 30% of engaged; numeric value: 24.0; detail: Secure documented diligence access and conditional control where appropriate. Obtain preliminary counterparty economics before ordering expensive reports or committing deposits.; label: Monetized opportunities; value: 17 parcels; 70.83% of controlled; numeric value: 17.0; detail: Close four telecom transactions and five billboard assignments; activate eight leased yards. Overall cohort conversion is 4.25%, with annual IOS revenue dependent on full-year occupancy and payment.

rect.title: label: Mapped opportunities; value: 400 unique parcel records; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Deduplicate by parcel and proposed rights package before counting. Capture source date, owner contact route, traffic or telecom evidence, and the proposed use.

label: Desktop-qualified opportunities; value: 200 parcels; 50% of mapped; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Remove incompatible zoning, unsuitable access, obvious sign-spacing conflicts, and absent buyer demand. Retain a recorded reason for every exclusion.

label: Owner-engaged opportunities; value: 80 parcels; 40% of qualified; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Confirm the owner's identity and transaction interest, obtain relevant leases, and establish a credible route to inspect title and site conditions.

label: Controlled diligence opportunities; value: 24 parcels; 30% of engaged; numeric value: 24.0; detail: Secure documented diligence access and conditional control where appropriate. Obtain preliminary counterparty economics before ordering expensive reports or committing deposits.

label: Monetized opportunities; value: 17 parcels; 70.83% of controlled; numeric value: 17.0; detail: Close four telecom transactions and five billboard assignments; activate eight leased yards. Overall cohort conversion is 4.25%, with annual IOS revenue dependent on full-year occupancy and payment.

text.title: Assumptions: The same 400 unique parcel opportunities flow through every stage; each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Conversions are planning assumptions, not observed performance. The cohort represents a mature annual operating period, not a promise to close within the first 30 days.
